items.question: "What about spare parts from China? Will I wait a month?"
items.answer: No. We keep key spare parts in stock in Poland - seals, filters, buckets, and hydraulic components. For 1–1.5 t mini excavators, we use components compatible with Kubota and Yanmar, available from Polish distributors. Typical repair time: 48–72 hours.

items.question: "Who will repair it? No service center knows these machines."
items.answer: We will. We have our own mobile technical service. Every machine comes with complete service documentation in Polish. The diesel engines in our machines are standard units - any experienced mechanic can handle them. Every machine is delivered with a Polish-language user manual and parts catalog.

items.question: "A Chinese excavator is just a toy. It will not survive on a construction site."
items.answer: Look at the numbers. The market for Chinese-made mini excavators in Poland is growing by 30–40% year over year. Leaders such as Gunter Shop, XTM, and Meyer Europe sell only machines from China. The difference? Our machines cost 30–40% less with identical working parameters.

items.q: Does the mini excavator require registration or operator permissions?
items.a: Mini excavators up to 5 tons do not require registration or operator licenses when used on private property. For work on public roads, machine liability insurance is required.

items.q: How do I transport the excavator to the construction site?
items.a: Our mini excavators fit on a standard car trailer up to 3.5 t GVW. Transporting them on a trailer with a passenger car is not a problem.

items.q: How long does machine delivery take?
items.a: In-stock machines are delivered within 5–14 business days. Built-to-order models take up to 3–4 weeks. Current availability is provided with the quotation.

items.q: Can I buy it for my company and use leasing?
items.a: Yes. We issue VAT invoices for both companies and private individuals. We work with leasing companies - the installment for a BM12 is about PLN 650–800 per month with a 60-month lease.

items.q: What happens if something breaks after a year?
items.a: The warranty covers 24 months. After it ends, we offer paid mobile service and spare parts sales from our warehouse in Poland.

items.q: Can I test the machine before purchase?
items.a: Yes - we invite you to a presentation at our showroom in Poznań. You can personally test the machine in action. Contact us to arrange a date.

items.q: Will the machine fit through a narrow gate or wicket?
items.a: The BM10 has a track width of 760 mm and fits through most standard gates. The BM12 and BM12C are 980 mm wide.

items.q: Are the mini excavators new? Do they have CE certificates?
items.a: All machines are brand new and come with a CE declaration of conformity. We provide full technical documentation and a user manual in Polish.
